stages.name: transactional_schema_migration
stages.tool: Python sqlite3 transactional migration plus explicit pre-migration snapshot
checks: The first attempt reached the report writer but failed on a Python boolean spelling error; the main index was restored from the explicit v1 snapshot before retry.
The clean retry removed the legacy source/page/record/model/dimensions uniqueness constraint and introduced schema version 2 child and parent fields.
Two approved page-baseline rows were preserved and four approved 512/100 child rows were added, for six total rows.
Three repeated executions finished with the same six rows and stable contract digest, proving idempotent upsert behavior.

stages.name: parent_page_collapse
checks: Traditional Chinese and English habitual-constipation queries rank PDF page 192 first after max-score parent collapse.
Each four-child raw result is collapsed to two distinct parent pages, removing two duplicate overlap hits before top-k.
The chromosome-count query remains blocked because no required book term occurs in any approved child chunk.
Every collapsed result retains source_id, volume, PDF page and record_id citation fields.

stages.name: portable_n8n_harness
stages.tool: n8n 2.12.3 CLI import plus canonical/database JSON comparison
checks: PEHybridIdx001 now runs only the idempotent migration and independent child-index validator.
Imported nodes, connections and settings match the canonical workflow JSON.
The workflow remains inactive, n8n remains stopped, and no Gemini key or secrets file is required by this migration harness.
A rollback database snapshot is present.

stages.name: independent_regression
stages.tool: existing corpus, record, grounding, chat, policy, embedding, chunking and SQLite validators
checks: The 1,774-page FTS corpus, both plant records, 15 chat API cases, seven policy cases and Cibotium grounding remained valid.
The prior page-baseline embedding report and three-profile A/B report remain valid in the same vector space.
Main and n8n SQLite integrity checks returned ok; tracked lab files passed the Gemini key scan.
The selected child JSONL was promoted to the top-level canonical data/chunks directory without changing its bytes.

stages.name: remaining_volumes_and_images
checks: No volume-2 or volume-3 pages were processed and image reasoning remains disabled.
stages.retry_target: Select one bounded volume-2 text sample and rerun the same chunking and evidence gates.

warnings: The active child profile is approved only for the Podophyllum pages and future bounded samples; it is not a full-volume promotion.
Parent collapse currently uses maximum cosine per parent page; future lexical/semantic fusion must collapse after channel fusion but before final top-k.
The local chat API still uses deterministic approved records and has not yet been rewired to arbitrary semantic retrieval.
